messages:
maya.cust: Hi team — trying to apply promo code REDWOODTRIAL2026 during account signup, it returns 'Promo code invalid or expired'. Tried twice. Can someone check?
emma_support: sorry about that! can you DM email or share the account email here? also which code exactly? (caps/spaces matter)
maya.cust: it's REDWOODTRIAL2026 (no spaces). Account email maya+startup@gmail.com. Getting this from dashboard and CLI.
maya.cust: log from CLI: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/promos/apply -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"code":"REDWOODTRIAL2026"}'``` response: {"error":"promo.invalid","message":"Code invalid or expired"}
emma_support: thanks. looking now. quick check shows that code REDWOODTRIAL2026 was part of a time-limited campaign and expired 2025-12-31. i'll escalate to billing since you're within onboarding window and should get help. were there any charges on this account?
maya.cust: new signup, no charges yet. thought trial grant would apply automatically from signup flow.
support-bot: Ticket created #SUP-3257 by @emma_support — assigning to billing.
kai_billing: taking this. maya — since the public code expired we can either issue a manual trial credit ($50) or extend trial period by 14 days. which would you prefer?
maya.cust: credit would be great. also curious why the dashboard didn't show the code as expired (no banner or note).
kai_billing: noted on UI feedback. i'll apply a manual credit and attach an internal promo for you. ETA ~30m. can you confirm account id (acct_??) or user id?
maya.cust: acct_0248 — thanks!
kai_billing: done — manual credit of $50 applied to acct_0248 and internal promo tag attached (note: manual_promo/2026-issue). added audit note: 'manual promo applied due to expired public campaign for onboarding.' please try creating a workspace or request.
maya.cust: verified! credit present and provisioning worked. thanks so much :tada:
emma_support: marking resolved on our side. we'll follow up with product to add expiry banner to promo UI. cc @product for visibility.
_meta: This thread captures a support escalation where a customer reported an expired/invalid promo code. Short Slack-style messages, a CLI repro snippet, a support-bot ticket creation line, and a manual credit resolution are included.
